question: Does the exact current head have sufficient immutable historical reconciliation and final release-candidate replay evidence to become the authoritative release verifier?
rationale: The PR is release-critical and explicitly conditions merge on real-history proof that focused fixture tests cannot replace; the currently cited workflow metadata does not independently establish that proof.

options.title: Keep the replay hold
options.body: Require a successful exact-head immutable reconciliation and final-candidate replay before approval.

options.title: Accept recovered evidence
options.body: A release owner may accept the existing evidence only after independently confirming that preserved Testbox logs executed the reviewed SHA and completed every claimed command before cancellation.

recommendation.title: Keep the replay hold
recommendation.body: Require a successful exact-head immutable reconciliation and final-candidate replay before approval.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned feature owner designed the reconciliation and is best positioned to produce a SHA-bound proof packet.
